about: GLM-5.3-Flash, Mia TensorFold EXL3 4 bpw checkpoint with a DFlash2 drafter, on TensorFold v0.6.0 plus the repository's patches, tensor-parallel over two DGX Sparks on RoCE: 4 requests at once, a 1,048,576-token window (MiaAI-Lab/GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3-2x-DGX-Sparks-TensorFold at bf5f945) with four exact decode settings from HOM-489: one-stream path for a lone request (TF_GLM_MULTI_LONE=1), expert block order 1, draft policy fnc7:0.4, copy drafts off
setup: Two DGX Sparks on one RoCE link (ConnectX-7, a shared subnet, the same MTU on both), one rank each; rank 0 drives the worker over key-based ssh and serves the API on 8888. One-command route: clone the source at the commit below on the head, copy scripts/local.sh.example to scripts/local.sh and set WORKER (ssh target of rank 1), MASTER_ADDR (an address of the head the worker reaches) and SOCKET_NET (the address prefix of the shared network), then run ./start.sh with TF_GLM_MULTI_LONE=1 TF_GLM_EXL3_DEC_ORDER=1 DRAFT_POLICY=fnc7:0.4 COPY=0 MEMORY_RESERVE_GIB=21 MAX_TOKENS=1048576: the first start builds the image from the repository's patches (scripts/prepare.sh writes the Dockerfile inline; the repository has no Dockerfile), downloads the two pinned weights (~164 GiB), copies image and weights to the worker, compiles kernels, starts rank 1 then rank 0 and waits for the API. Memory: MEMORY_RESERVE_GIB=21 (the recipe default 14.5 left 8-9 GiB free on the head while serving); measured lowest MemAvailable while serving 15 GiB head / 17 GiB worker.
